recommendation_summary: Right now: make either of the two qualified engineers enough to approve in the tracker the team already uses, and put one of them on every open change where the lead is the only reviewer. Nothing optional is added. Squads, Jira Align and workshops are dropped outright. The core need, changes stalling while the lead is away, is fully addressed.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for an operating model you can launch this week so the team ships faster. The squad, chapter, Jira Align, and quarterly workshop ideas came from you, from Spotify and peer adoption, and from budget you can spend.
labels.Deleted: Spotify squads and chapters, Jira Align, and quarterly planning workshops. The last six changes show no failure that those would fix.
labels.Bottleneck: Approval. Coding on each of those six took less than a day, then each waited three days because the lead was the only assigned reviewer and was away.
labels.Checked myself: What you told me: four engineers in one time zone, statuses in the existing tracker, those six changes, and two other engineers already qualified and authorized to approve them.
